title: # 28. The Battle Of Uhud Part 4
arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ ۝ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراَّ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says;

قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ سُنَنٌ فَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ۝

لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ۝

وَكَانَ نَبِيُّ بَعْثَه’ اِلَى قَوْمِه خَاصَهْ وَبُعِثْتُ اِلَى النَّاسِ عَامَّهْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنْتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ۝

كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; إِنْ يَمْسَسْكُمْ قَرْحٌ فَقَدْ مَسَّ الْقَوْمَ قَرْحٌ مِثْلُهُ ۚ وَتِلْكَ الْأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيْنَ النَّاسِ

وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنْكُمْ شُهَدَاءَ ۗ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ۝

وَلِيُمَحِّصَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَيَمْحَقَ الْكَافِرِينَ۝

أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا مِنْكُمْ وَيَعْلَمَ الصَّابِرِينَ۝

وَلَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ تَمَنَّوْنَ الْمَوْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَلْقَوْهُ فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُمُوهُ وَأَنْتُمْ تَنْظُرُونَ۝

إِنْ يَمْسَسْكُمْ قَرْحٌ فَقَدْ مَسَّ الْقَوْمَ قَرْحٌ مِثْلُهُ ۚ وَتِلْكَ الْأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيْنَ النَّاسِ اَنَّ حِكْمَة الله وَ سُنَّتَه’ فِيْ رُسُلِهِ وَاَتْبَاعِهِمْ جَرَتْ بِاَنْ يُدَالُوا مَرَّة وَ يُدَالُوا عَلَيْهِمْ اُخْرَى،

لَكِنْ تَكُوْنُ لَهُمُ الْعَاقِبَهْ فَاِنَّهُمْ لَوْ اِنْتَصَرُوْدَآئِمًا دَخَلَ مَعَه’اَلْمُؤمِنُوْنَ وَغَيْرَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَتَمَيَّزْ اَلصَّادِقْ مِنْ غَيْرَه

وَلَوْ اِنْتَصِرَ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِمًا لَمْ يَحْصِلِ الْمَقْصُوْدْ مِنَّ الْبِعْثَة وَالرِّسَالَهْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا

وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنْكُمْ شُهَدَاءَ اِنَّ اشَّهَادَتَ عِنْدَه’ مِنْ اَعْلَى مَرَاتِ بِاَوْلِيَآْءِ وَشُّهَدَآءُهُمْ خَوَاصُه’ وَالْمٌقَرَّبُوْنَ عَلَيْه

وَشُّهَدَآءُهُمْ خَوَاصُه’ وَالْمٌقَرَّبُوْنَ إلَيْه وَلَا سَبِيْلَ اِلَى نَيْلِ هَذِهِ الدَّرَجَة اِلَّا بِتَقْدِيْرِ الْاَسْبَابِ الْمُفْضِيَّةِ اِلَيْهَا مِنْ تَسْلِيْط الْعَدُّوّْ

وَلِيُمَحِّصَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَيَمْحَقَ الْكَافِرِينَ۝

وَلِيُمَحِّصَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلِيُمَحِّصَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَيَمْحَقَ الْكَافِرِينَ۝

لاَ تَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ خَافِيَةٌ أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا مِنْكُمْ وَيَعْلَمَ الصَّابِرِينَ۝

وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا مِنْكُمْ وَلَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ تَمَنَّوْنَ الْمَوْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَلْقَوْهُ فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُمُوهُ وَأَنْتُمْ تَنْظُرُونَ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ said; وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ  ۗ وَمَا النَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ اِنَّ اللهَ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ۝

لَوْلَا كِتَابٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَا أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَلَقَدْ عَفَا عَنْكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ قَاتَلَ مَعَهُ رِبِّيُّونَ كَثِيرٌ فَمَا وَهَنُوا فَمَا وَهَنُوا لِمَا أَصَابَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَمَا ضَعُفُوا وَمَا اسْتَكَانُوا ۗ

وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الصَّابِرِينَ۝

وَمَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوا رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ۝

فَآتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ ثَوَابَ الدُّنْيَا وَحُسْنَ ثَوَابِ الْآخِرَةِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ۝

أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَأُولِي الْأَمْرِ مِنْكُمْ ۖ

فَإِنْ تَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي شَيْءٍ فَرُدُّوهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًا۝

وَسَاءتْ فِيْه اَخْلَاقُنَا وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ ۚ أَفَإِنْ مَاتَ أَوْ قُتِلَ انْقَلَبْتُمْ عَلَىٰ أعْقَابِكُمْ ۚ

وَمَنْ يَنْقَلِبْ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ فَلَنْ يَضُرَّ اللَّهَ شَيْئًا ۗ وَسَيَجْزِي اللَّهُ الشَّاكِرِينَ۝

مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُوْ مُحَمَّدً فَاِنَّ مُحَمَّدً قَدْ مَاتْ ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُالله فَاِنَّ الله حَيُّ الَّا يَمُوْتْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says;

فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ لِنْتَ لَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كُنْتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ الْقَلْبِ لَانْفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِكَ ۖ فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ ۖ

فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ۝

وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَمَا أَصَابَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا ۚ وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا قَاتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوِ ادْفَعُوا ۖ قَالُوا لَوْ نَعْلَمُ قِتَالًا لَاتَّبَعْنَاكُمْ ۗ

هُمْ لِلْكُفْرِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَقْرَبُ مِنْهُمْ لِلْإِيمَانِ ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ مَا لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَكْتُمُونَ۝

وَلَقَدْ صَدَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ إِذْ تَحُسُّونَهُمْ بِإِذْنِهِ ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَشِلْتُمْ وَتَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَعَصَيْتُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَرَاكُمْ مَا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ

مِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرِيدُ الدُّنْيَا وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرِيدُ الْآخِرَةَ ۚ ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ لِيَبْتَلِيَكُمْ ۖ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا عَنْكُمْ ۗ

وَاللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

اُحَدْ جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ اُحَدْ جَبَلٌ فِيْ الْجَنَّةْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says, وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ

وَمَا النَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; إِنْ يَنْصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ ۗ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ۝

وَلَقَدْ صَدَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ إِذْ تَحُسُّونَهُمْ بِإِذْنِهِ ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَشِلْتُمْ وَتَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَعَصَيْتُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَرَاكُمْ مَا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ

مِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرِيدُ الدُّنْيَا وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرِيدُ الْآخِرَةَ ۚ ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ لِيَبْتَلِيَكُمْ ۖ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا عَنْكُمْ ۗ

وَاللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ۝

وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَأَنْتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ۝

لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَوَاطِنَ كَثِيرَةٍ ۙ وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ ۙ وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ ۙ إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنْكُمْ شَيْئًا

وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُمْ مُدْبِرِينَ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَنَازَعُوا فَتَفْشَلُوا وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ ۖ وَاصْبِرُوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ۝

وَأَعِدُّوا لَهُمْ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَمِنْ رِبَاطِ الْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَآخَرِينَ مِنْ دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ ۚ

وَمَا تُنْفِقُوا مِنْ شَيْءٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَاثْبُتُوا وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ۝

الله اكبر، سبحان الله ،لا اله الا الله يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا زَحْفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ الْأَدْبَارَ۝

وَثْبُتُوْ صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا وَالسلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته
english:
The Life of Muhammadﷺ, The Madinan Period, Volume 1 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki, We all know Uhud(أحَد), to be a defeat, but the amazing thing is that Ibn Al-Qayyim(ابن القيم) thinks otherwise.

Ibn Al-Qayyim(ابن القيم) says that it is a victory for the Muslims.

The reason why it's a victory for the Muslims is because it's a gold mine of lessons.

When the rumors spread that Muhammadﷺ was killed some of the Muslims were trying to find a way to meet with Abdullah Bin Obaeye(عبدالله بن ابيئ)

to have him intercede with the Kuffar(كفار) of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), to give them truce.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ taught us a lesson, Allahعَزّوجَلّ said; Muhammad(محمد) is not but a messenger.

Other messengers have passed on before him.

Muhammadﷺ is a messenger and there are other messengers before him and where are they now?

They're dead.

So, the same thing, death, should be expected to happen to Muhammadﷺ, if all of the other prophets are dead.

Why do you think or assume that Muhammadﷺ wouldn't die as they did?

And then Allah said, so if he was to die or to be killed?

Would you then turn back on your heels to unbelief?

Is that how you're going to react his death just because Muhammadﷺ died you're going to give up your religion.

And he who turns back on his heels will never harm Allah at all, you are the ones who need Allah, Allah doesn't need you.

But Allah will reward the Grateful.

This is Al-Imran(العمران) One (hundred) fouty four(144).

Therefore Allah telling us that this religion does not depend on personalities.

The fate of this religion is not hinged to any person even if that person is the great and noble person of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, if that's the case with Rasool Allah ﷺ, we should never think or believe if such and such person is killed, that this religion the advance of this religion will stop,

we should never assume that the victory is dependent on a particular leader.

And that's why Umar Bin Khattab(عمر بن خطاب) fired Khalid Ibn Waleed رضي الله عنه from his post of the general of the Muslim armies.

He wanted people to know that victory is not because of Khalid Ibn Waleed(خالد ابن وليد), victory is because of Allah.

It is Allah, Who brought us victory, it is not Khalid Ibn Waleed(خالد ابن وليد).

So, Muslims who are waiting now for a particular leader or are depending on a particular leader, you should depend on Allah.

Allah did not allow the Muslims to depend on Muhammadﷺ, Allah told them if Muhammad(محمد) dies, you need to carry on, being Muslims, carry on spreading the message as if nothing changed.

You should not retreat and fall back on your heels.

Because this religion is dependent on, No One and that's why when Abu Bakr Siddique رضي الله عنه came to Madina after the death of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

What did he say to the people.

Whoever worships Muhammad(محمد), Muhammad(محمد) is dead.

But whoever worships Allah, Allah is alive and never dies.

How did the Prophet deal with the archers and the hypocrites, the archers disobeyed him and the hypocrites also disobeyed him.

So, how did he deal with them?

He dealt with him differently.

Let's look at how he dealt with the archers.

So, by mercy from Allah, O Muhammad(محمد), you were lenient with them.

And if you had been rude in speech and harsh in heart, they would have disbanded from about you.

So, Allah is saying Muhammadﷺ, your method of Da'wah(دعوة) has been based on being lenient, being soft, not being harsh in word or speech, not being rude in speech or harsh in heart.

That is how, you were able to bring these hearts together.

So, how do you deal with the archers.?

Allah said: So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them.

Subhaan Allah(سبحان الله), we lost because of them, Rasool Allah ﷺ was injured because of them, 70 Muslims were killed because of them and then you pardon them and not only pardon them,

but Allah wants you to ask forgiveness for them.

You Muhammadﷺ, who suffered because of their mistake, you ask Allahعَزّوجَلّ to forgive them.

And Subhaan Allah(سبحان الله), we talked about the Shura(شورى), and we said that some of the Muslims, the youth, especially and the ones, who missed the Battle of Badr(بدر),

were asking Rasool Allah ﷺ to go out and fight outside Madina.

And we said that this wasn't the opinion of Rasool Allah ﷺ, the opinion of Rasool Ullah that we stay in Madina and fight from within.

And that was the better opinion, it was opinion of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, that is also probably one of the reasons why they lost.

Nevertheless, Allahعَزّوجَلّ said and consult them in the matter, even if consultation has led to your defeat.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ is saying don't let that prevent you from making Shura(شورى) again.

So, we carry on with Shura(شورى) even if the result of the Shura(شورى) was wrong.

You still carry on with Shura(شورى), Shura(شورى) is the right way to go.

Look at the lessons, this Ghazwah(غزوة) is loaded with lessons.

Shura(شورى), carry on with Shura(شورى).

And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah.

So, after you make Shura(شورى) and you decide, you go ahead, you don't waver, you don't change, you don't oscillate.

Allah loves those, who rely upon Him.

Have Tawwakkul(توكل) in Allah.

So, how do you deal with the archers?

Number one, pardon them.

Number two, ask forgiveness for them.

Number three, consult them, consult the Muslims, even if they have given you a wrong opinion, carry on consulting them.

So, if this was the instruction of Allah to the prophet of Allah, who is receiving Wahii(وحي) from Allah.

Who's infallible.

What about the poor, humble men like us?

How important does that make Shura(شورى) for us.

That's how he dealt with the archers.

How did he deal with the Munafiqoon(منافقون)?

Allah says , Surat Al-Imran(العمران) Verse 166, 167.

And what struck you on the day, the two armies met at Uhud(أحَد), was by the permission of Allah, that He might make evident the true believers,

and that He might make evident those who are hypocrites, for it was said to them come fight in the way of Allah, or at least defend.

They said, if we had known there would be fighting we would have followed you.

They were nearer to disbelieve that day then to faith, saying with their mouths, what was not in their hearts and Allah is the most knowing of what they conceal, that was it.

It was exposing them, but they were not punished.

That was it, they were just exposed.

So, I want to bring up an important lesson here There are some Muslims.

In fact, there are entire movements that are based upon this false hypothesis.

There are some Muslims who say that for the Ummah(امة), to succeed and be victorious.

We have to invite them all to truth, and they all have to obey Allah and avoid sins.

And as long as there are Muslims who don't pray, Muslims who are committing sins, we're not going to win.

And we're not going to win until the Muslims who pray Fajr(فجر) are equal in number to the Muslims who pray Jum'ah(جمعه), and then they bring you this saying of that Rabbi,

who went and visited the holy Mosque of Jerusalem and said that Jerusalem will fall in Muslim hands, when the people, who are praying Fajr(فجر) are equal to the people, who are praying Jum'ah(جمعه),

and we start listening to all of this stuff.

And the Rabbi said, this and Rabbi said this and this Rabbi said that, as if it's the Rabbi's, who are receiving the Wahee(وحي) of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

That's not a correct hypothesis.

There will always be more Muslims who pray Jum'ah(جمعه) than Muslims who pray Fajr(فجر), And there will always be Muslims who commit sins, there will always be Muslims, who commit major sins,

there will always be Muslims who are not fulfilling the obligations, this will always be the case.

And if you are waiting for victory to come, when all Muslims are righteous, and all Muslims are Auleaa(إولياء) of Allah, that will never happen.

And to prove to you that this hypothesis is wrong, is the fact that one third of the Muslim army defected.

Those were the Munafiqoon(منافقون) and this did not affect the outcome of the battle of Uhud(أحَد).

The Munafiqoon(منافقون), who left with Abdullah Bin Obaey(عبدالله بن أبي), were not the reason for the Muslim defeat.

This wasn't mentioned as a reason in Sunnah(سنة) and it's not mentioned as a reason in Qur'an, therefore it's not one of the reasons, it's not the reason, it's not even one of the reasons, why the Muslims lost.

The joining of the Munafiqeen(منافقين) or their defection wouldn't have made a difference.

And since there will always be Munafiqoon(منافقون) living among the Muslim Ummah(امة), they will not affect the outcome of the battle between good and evil.

The outcome is affected by the core group of Muslims.

The Taifah Al-Mansourah(الطائفة المنصوره), Rasool Allah ﷺ has talk about a core group of Muslims called Taifah Al-Mansourah(الطائفة المنصوره).

This is the saved group, it is these, who have to be on the straight path.

If they start sinning, then the Muslims will lose.

So, the outcome depends on them.

It doesn't depend on all of the Ummah(امة), see, the Ummah(امة) contains within its ranks, the righteous and the sinners, it contains the believers and the Munafiqeen(منافقين).

And it's always going to be like that, until the day of judgment.

But the ones, whom we should make sure that they are united and they are one and they are not disobeying Allahعَزّوجَلّ, are the Taifah Al-Mansourah(الطائفة المنصوره),

this core group of Muslims, they are the ones who need to be united.

Because their disobeying of Rasool Allah ﷺ, on that hill, was what brought defeat to the Muslims.

It was the action of those 40 men on the mountain that brought defeat to the Muslims.

It wasn't the 300 who left with Andullah Bin Obaey(عبدالله بن أبي) because Allahعَزّوجَلّ said; It was when, you disunited and you failed, and you disobeyed the messenger of Allah, that is when you lost.

Next lesson, you know, you would expect that the sight of the mountain of Uhud(أحَد), would bring back bad memories to Rasool Allah ﷺ, sad memories,

the defeat, in fact the first defeat of Muslims, the loss of Hamza Bin Abdul Muttalib(حمزه بن عبد المطلب), the dear uncle of Rasool Allah ﷺ, loss of 70 Shahadaa(شهدآء),

the injury of Rasool Allah ﷺ, so it's all bad memories but Rasool Allah ﷺ was optimistic.

And he hated pessimism.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Uhud(أحَد) is or a mountain that loves us, and we love it.

So, this mountain rather than bringing sad memories, no, it's a mountain that loves us and we love it.

And Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Uhud(أحَد) is a mountain in paradise.

So, throw away pessimism, throw away associating the mountain of Uhud(أحَد) with sad memories, No, whenever we see it, we will be we optimistic, whenever we see it, we will remember love.

We're not going to remember defeat and hardship and pain we're going to remember love.

This is a mountain that we love and it loves us.

This is an important lesson that the Muslim should always look at the bright side, and the Muslims should always be optimistic.

Next, the rules of victory and defeat in Surat Al-Anfaal(سورة الانفال) and Al-Imran (العمران).

There are many rules of victory and defeat.

But we'll stick to those mentioned in Al Imran(العمران) and Al-Anfaal(الانفال) because these are the two Sura's(سُوَر) revealed after Badr(بَدر) and Uhud(اُحَد)

and these are the two battles that we have talked about.

So, what are the rules of victory in Qur'an, specifically in Al-Imran(العمران) Al-Anfaal(الانفال).

Number one, first and foremost, victory is from Allah.

It belongs to Allah.

And victory is not but from Allah.

verse 10 Surat Al-Anfaal(سورة الانفال).

So it belongs to Him, It doesn't belong to your arms, it doesn't belong to your preparation.

It doesn't belong to a particular King or leader, it belongs to Allah.

Number two, if Allah wants to give you victory, no one, no power on earth can stop that from happening.

So, you should fear no one.

As long as Allah wants to hand you down His victory, it's going to happen.

He gave it to Musa(موسى).

When Musa(موسى) was fighting against Firaun(فرعون).

Verse 160 Al-Imran(العمران), if Allah should aid you no one can overcome you.

But if He should forsake you, who is there that can aid you after Him and upon Allah, the believers rely.

Rely on Allah because victory comes from Him.

And don't rely on anybody else.

Because if you rely on anybody else, Allah will forsake you.

Number three, attachment to this world and preferring it over Aakhira(آخرة) is a reason for defeat.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ said, and Allah has certainly fulfilled His promise to you, when you were killing them by His permission.

This was the beginning of the battle of Uhud(أحَد), they were winning, Until the time, when you lost courage, and fell to disputing about the order given by the prophet

and disobeyed him, after he had shown you that which you love, among you are some who desire this world.

See, because of this desire of this world, you lost.

Also a reason for losing, disobeying Rasool Allah ﷺ, another reason for losing is disunity and these are going to come up, obedience to Rasool Allah ﷺ in having unity.

Number four, numbers are not the cause for victory or defeat.

Lack of numbers doesn't bring defeat and overwhelming numbers do not bring victory.

This is very important to learn, don't depend on your numbers.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ said in Al-Imran(العمران), verse 123, And already had Allah given you victory in the Battle of Badr(بدر), when you were weak.

i.e. few in numbers.

you were few numbers in Badr(بدر) and nevertheless, you won.

While Allahعَزّوجَلّ say is about the Battle of Hunain(حنين).

And on the Day of Hunain(حنين), you were impressed by your numbers.

And those numbers didn't do you any good, they lost the battle of Hunain(حنين).

And Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; And how many small parties have defeated larger parties by the will of Allah.

This did not only happen with you Muhammadﷺ, it did happen with the righteous people before you, like the people of Talut(طالوت).

They were small in numbers and they still won.

So, numbers don't have anything to do with victory or defeat.

Number five, obeying Allahعَزّوجَلّ and His Messenger and we talked about this, number six unity, unity is important.

Number seven, perseverance.

And obey Allah and His messenger and do not dispute and thus lose courage.

And then your strength will depart and be patient.

Be patient here it says Was-Biroo(واصبروا), we could say that that is either patience, or perseverance.

Number eight, preparation.

Be prepared but don't depend on preparation, but Allahعَزّوجَلّ telling you, be prepared physically, mentally, militarily in terms of arms training, you need to be prepared

and prepare against them and this is in Surat Al-Anfaal(سورة الانفال) verse 60.

And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steals of war by which you may terrify the enemy of Allah and your enemy and others besides them,

whom you do not know but whom Allah knows, and whatever you spend in the cause of Allah will be fully repaired to you and you will not be wronged.

So, Muslims need to prepare.

Number nine and number 10, steadfastness and then remembrance of Allah and these are mentioned in one Ayah(آية), O you, who have believed, when you encounter a company from the enemy forces stand firm.

And remember Allah much that you may be successful.

So number one, stand firm.

Don't move from that spot.

Don't turn your back to the enemy.

And remember Allah, Zikr(ذكر) of Allahعَزّوجَلّ all the time.

Connect that heart to Allahعَزّوجَلّ you will win.

And this is verse 45, in Surat Al-Anfaal(سورة الانفال).

And another verse, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says, and this is Surat Al-Anfaal(سورة الانفال) verse 15; O you, who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieved advancing for battle,

do not turn them your backs in fight, stand firm.

We'll carry on with some other lessons from the Battle of Uhud(أحَد) In Sha Allah ho Ta'ala(ان شاءالله تعالى) tomorrow night.
